lines: Aankhon mein jal raha hai kyun, bujhta nahin dhuan
couplets.en: Why does the smoke still smolder in my eyes?

lines: Uthta to hai ghata sa, barasta nahin dhuan
couplets.en: The smoke rises like a rain cloud that will never break.

lines: Aankhon mein jal raha hai kyun, bujhta nahin dhuan
couplets.en: Why does the smoke still smolder in my eyes?

lines: Chulhe nahin jalaye, ya basti hi jal gayi
couplets.en: Did the hearths stay cold, or did the whole village burn?

lines: Kuchh roz ho gaye hain, ab uthta nahin dhuan
couplets.en: Days have passed, and the smoke no longer rises.

lines: Aankhon mein jal raha hai kyun, bujhta nahin dhuan
couplets.en: Why does the smoke still smolder in my eyes?

lines: Aankhon ke ponchhne se laga aanch ka pata
couplets.en: Only when I wiped my eyes did I feel the heat.

lines: Yun chehra pher lene se chhupta nahin dhuan
couplets.en: Turning your face away cannot hide the smoke.

lines: Aankhon se aansuon ke marasim purane hain
couplets.en: The eyes and their tears are old acquaintances.

lines: Mehmaan ye ghar mein aaye to chubhta nahin dhuan
couplets.en: When these guests come home, the smoke no longer stings.
